howToPlay: Jacky is a tank who excels at dealing area damage to enemies within her range. Use her Super to pull opponents close and rely on her Hardy Hard Hat or Counter Crush to survive incoming fire while moving into position.
gears: Equip the HEALTH gear to stay in the fight longer and the SUPER CHARGE gear to pull enemies in more frequently.
trait: This brawler is perfect for aggressive players who enjoy disrupting enemy teams and dominating close-range engagements.
